note: RESEARCH INCOMPLETE - tooling failure, not a clean bill of health. The DuckDuckGo search backend returned 'Connection refused' on all 4 attempts, so no sanctions, court, regulator, rating or news search could be executed. Only the company's own homepage (https://www.apcotex.com/) was readable: it confirms an active, listed-style Indian manufacturer of NBR/SBR latex and synthetic rubber with an investor-relations section (SEBI LODR Reg. 46/40 disclosures, IEPF, unclaimed dividend), which is consistent with a normal listed Indian company but is NOT evidence on any risk dimension. OFAC Sanctions List Search (https://sanctionssearch.ofac.treas.gov/) was reachable but is an interactive form - a static fetch returns no lookup results, so no name match could be confirmed or excluded; UN/EU/UK/BIS lists were not checked at all. Attempts to reach CRISIL ratings list and Apcotex investor sub-pages failed (SSL timeout / HTTP 404). All five risk fields are therefore null = not verified, not 'no findings'. No evidence of supplies to Russia or CIS was found, but no search was possible, so this must not be read as absence of such supplies. Recommended: re-run this company once the search backend is restored, checking OFAC SDN/UN/EU/UK/BIS lists by exact name, Indian court records (NCLT/eCourts) with party role, SEBI/exchange filings for regulator action, and CRISIL/ICRA/CARE rating rationales with dates.
